request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: Which requirements does Annex V to Legislative Decree 81/2008 lay down for the emergency stop devices of work equipment built in the absence of product directives?

response.text: {"kind": "unknown", "value": null, "text": "The files do not contain the text of Annex V to Legislative Decree 81/2008, so they do not state the emergency stop requirements for work equipment built without product directives. Article 70(2) of the decree (in DLGS70.md) only says such equipment must meet the general safety requirements of Annex V. The INAIL/EBER robot-cell sheet (robot-cell-sheet.md, p. 4) cites 'D.Lgs. 81/08 All. V' and describes emergency stop rules, but those rules come from the sheet's own text, not from Annex V.", "sources": [{"file": "DLGS70.md", "place": "Articolo 70, comma 2", "quote": "Le attrezzature di lavoro costruite in assenza di disposizioni legislative e regolamentari di cui al comma 1, e quelle messe a disposizione dei lavoratori antecedentemente all'emanazione di norme legislative e regolamentari di recepimento delle direttive comunitarie di prodotto, devono essere conformi ai requisiti generali di sicurezza di cui all'allegato V."}, {"file": "robot-cell-sheet.md", "place": "p. 4", "quote": "Ogni macchina deve essere dotata di almeno un comando di arresto di emergenza (vedi 2.2.6.4 \"Arresto d'emergenza\") collocato in posizione facilmente raggiungibile dall'operatore."}]}
